mechanics.claim: Toxic Shot's bonus on-hit magic damage and poison are applied by Teemo's basic attacks, not a separate cast.
mechanics.quote: '''Teemo's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and inflict {{tip|poison}}

mechanics.claim: Poison deals magic damage every second for 4 seconds, and reapplication refreshes rather than stacks the duration.
mechanics.quote: The target takes {{as|magic damage}} every second over 4 seconds. Subsequent inflictions refresh the duration.

mechanics.claim: The poison tick damage does not update based on Teemo's AP at the time of the tick.
mechanics.quote: The damage per tick is not updated dynamically based on '''Teemo's''' current ability power.

mechanics.claim: Toxic Shot deals increased damage against monsters (not applicable to a champion dummy target).
Toxic Shot deals proc/persistent damage and does not trigger most spell effects, though it is special cased for certain items/runes.
mechanics.quote: ''Toxic Shot'' deals {{tip|proc damage|proc}} {{tip|persistent damage|damage over time}}, and does not trigger {{tip|spell effects}}.
